description: Product Requirement Prompt framework for AI agents to ship production-ready code on the first pass
rules: PRPs must include comprehensive context and validation loops
Use structured PRP templates with Goal, Why, What, Context, Implementation, and Validation sections
Always include executable validation commands for syntax, tests, and integration
Leverage existing Claude commands in .claude/commands/ directory
Follow the principle: Context is King - include all necessary documentation and examples
Use TodoWrite tool for task management and progress tracking
Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones unless absolutely necessary
